title: 6 Hour Specialty Fishing Trip @ Calabash
includes: All rods, reels, tackle, bait, and fishing licenses are included
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Climb aboard the spacious Navigator and set off on an exciting 6 hour Bottom Fishing Trip with Calabash Fishing Fleet! Designed for comfort and adventure, this trip is limited to 25 passengers, giving you more room to move, more personalized attention, and better fishing opportunities throughout the journey.
Perfect for families, groups, beginners, and seasoned anglers, this action‑packed experience offers the chance to reel in a variety of prized Carolina coast species while enjoying a fun and friendly atmosphere on the water.
